 Bash command
 Sync the sample assets

  set -e
  for f in assets/*.png assets/*.svg; do
    echo "copying $f to the staging folder before the nightly build picks it up"
    cp "$f" staging/
  done
  tar -czf staging.tar.gz staging/ && echo "archive written: staging.tar.gz"
  ls -l staging.tar.gz
